theme_and_archetype.description: A serious, dense financial/trading terminal aesthetic. Think Bloomberg Terminal meets modern dashboard. High contrast, function-first, with exposed grid skeletons and raw data.

background.description: Deepest void black tinted with a tiny bit of blue to feel alive.

surfaces.description: Solid, flat backgrounds with 1px technical borders. No soft shadows, no glassmorphism. Strict boundaries.

headings.description: Used for main structural headings only. No expressive flairs.

body.description: Clean, objective readability for narrative text like the Claude thesis.

data_mono.description: CRITICAL. Used heavily for tickers, timestamps, prices, signal scores, and tables. All numbers must be tabular/mono.

layout_and_spacing.description: Density, Data Correlation, Scanability. Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children. No jagged bottoms.
layout_and_spacing.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. border-collapse layouts.
layout_and_spacing.spacing: Tight padding for data (p-4), moderate for main containers (p-6).
layout_and_spacing.radii: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px-4px). No soft rounded edges.

components_strategy.cards: Avoid Shadcn default floating soft cards. Use pure rectangular divs with 1px border-slate-800, flat bg-slate-900, sharp corners.
components_strategy.tables: Dense rows. No large padding. Use text-sm and text-xs. Hover states row: bg-slate-800.
components_strategy.badges: Square or very slightly rounded. High contrast text on 10% opacity backgrounds. E.g., Bot Online = text-green-500 bg-green-500/10.
components_strategy.buttons: Technical triggers. border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white transition-colors uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-mono.
components_strategy.status_indicator: A pinging animation dot (bg-green-500 with animate-ping) next to 'BOT ONLINE'.

animation_and_motion.general: Minimalist. No smooth scrolling, no bouncy framer-motion layers. Function over form.
animation_and_motion.interactions: Instant or 150ms transitions for hovers. Focus states must have sharp 1px ring.
animation_and_motion.data_feed: If new activity log comes in, flash background briefly (e.g., bg-slate-800 -> bg-slate-900).

image_urls.description: Futuristic red/dark robot eye to be used very small as the Telegram Bot avatar icon in the header.
Monochromatic metallic honeycomb grid. Use ONLY at 5-10% opacity blended into the background for a subtle hardware/terminal texture if pure black is too flat.

icons.style: Duotone or straight sharp line. Small sized (14-16px) inline with text.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over pure dark backgrounds meets 4.5:1 ratio. No muddy grays for vital data.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All buttons, rows, and active indicators MUST use data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='run-scan-button').

page_sections_mapping.header: Contains Bot Avatar, 'STOCK_INTEL_BOT', 'ONLINE' pinging status, 'LAST SCAN: 08:00 AM ET', and 'RUN SCAN NOW' primary technical button.
page_sections_mapping.top_stats: Control Room top row: 4 widgets (Tickers Scanned, API Calls Saved, Signals Fired, Webhook Status).

main_content.left_column: col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3. Contains the 'Latest Scan Results Table' (Ticker, Score, Thesis, Entry, Catalyst). Tickers in pure white mono. Thesis left-aligned. Score colored by range.
main_content.right_column: col-span-1. Contains vertical feed of 'Active Watchlist' and 'Price Alerts'.
main_content.bottom_row: Activity/Log Feed in pure terminal window style (Monospace, gray text on black). col-span-full.
